metadata.description: flipback - put the agent back on when it stops early.

plugins.name: flipback
plugins.description: A Stop hook that reads the conversation when your agent ends its turn and decides whether the work actually got done. Partial delivery, announced-but-not-done work, stopping at the first error, TODOs left as finished, questions asked into an empty room - it hands back the specific unfinished thing and the agent carries on. Bounded to one nudge per turn. Ships a skill that teaches the agent to catch its own early stops.
